command:
set -eu
sudo mount /mnt/inventory
proof="inventory-bind-$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid)"
printf '%s\n' "$proof" | sudo tee /mnt/inventory/.bind-mount-proof >/dev/null
printf 'mount='
findmnt -rn -T /mnt/inventory -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
printf 'source_inode='
stat -c '%d:%i' /srv/inventory
printf 'target_inode='
stat -c '%d:%i' /mnt/inventory
printf 'source_data='
sudo cat /srv/inventory/.bind-mount-proof
printf 'target_data='
sudo cat /mnt/inventory/.bind-mount-proof
mountpoint -q /mnt/inventory
